_comment: Stronger-amplitude single moving target for the extended-target tracking sweep (target realism report, Part II). Amplitude 0.0009 (cf. Part I section 4.3) so the object is reliably DETECTED -- the tracking failures studied here are clustering fragmentation and glint, not missed detections. Velocity 0.5 m/s matches report 2's missed-detection scenario (its anchor). The sweep injects `extent` and varies clustering / matched R per cell; extent=None reproduces the report-2 point-target behaviour (one CLEAN track).
